name: Mr. Baker
why_it_matters: Pinjore's reliable everyday bakery on the Kalka-Pinjore Road, a 10-minute drive from Yadavindra Gardens. Built up a 1,000-plus review reputation on Zomato and Justdial without a city-Chandigarh listing, which is itself a quiet local-loyalty signal in a town this small. Cleanest tea-and-pastry stop after the gardens.
insider_tip: Walk in for the fresh-out-of-the-oven bread bun at 9-10am or 4-5pm; mid-day stocks are picked over by Kalka commuters. Cash and UPI both fine.
signature_address: Kalka Pinjore Road, Khurana Colony, Pinjore, Panchkula district, Haryana 134102

name: Goyal's Chandigarh Sweets
signature_dish: kaju katli and jalebi (made on premises)
why_it_matters: Pinjore's standalone sweet-shop-and-snack counter in Shiv Shakti Colony, near UCO Bank. Two Facebook outlets and full Zomato/Justdial/MagicPin coverage suggest a working everyday business rather than a listicle ghost. Useful for the after-gardens box-of-sweets reflex you'll find every Punjabi family acting on at the gate.
insider_tip: Order the freshly-fried jalebi with rabdi in winter mornings; afternoon batches sit. Stick to the mithai counter and cold lassi - the chaat side has had service complaints in 2024 reviews.
signature_address: Near UCO Bank, Shiv Shakti Colony, Pinjore, Panchkula district, Haryana 134102
